title: Fix the vacuous ChazaraInlineSetup custom-round tests in edit_track_screen_l1_test.dart
rule: TQ-8 (tautological tests / assertions weaker than what the source can do wrong)
why: The file's own header claims coverage of 'Custom cycle enforces min 1 / max 5 rounds', and the real production logic exists (step_chazara.dart:295 onRemove null guard, :302-303 'if (_customDelays.length < 5) AddRoundChip'), but all 3 tests against it are vacuous: two probe icon constants (Icons.add_circle_outline_rounded, Icons.add_rounded) that AddRoundChip never renders — it renders Icons.add, confirmed by reading chazara_widgets.dart:196 — so their assertions pass independent of real widget behavior, and the third asserts List.length >= 0, a Dart-level tautology that is always true. A future change that broke min/max-round enforcement entirely (always 6+ rounds allowed, or the last round removable) would leave this whole test group green.
recommendation: Fix the icon finders to Icons.add scoped via a Key/byWidgetPredicate (to avoid ambiguity with the unrelated TinyCircleButton Icons.add elsewhere), fix initialDelays: [1] to [3] in the add-round test per its own comment so it actually starts in custom mode, and replace the tautological length check with a real assertion on round count / IconButton.onPressed before vs after.
acceptance_criteria: Deliberately make _customDelays.length < 5 unconditionally true and confirm the 'hidden at 5' test now fails
Deliberately make onRemove always non-null and confirm the 'remove absent at 1' test now fails
